{{Quote|I am Ceetoo Deefour, former translator to Her Imminence, Queen Lina of Onderon; and this is my current master, the renowned illicit-transport specialist Jakarro.|C2-D4|<ref name="Depths" />}}
'''Lina''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] who was the [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C2-D4]] served Queen Lina's [[Royal court of Onderon|royal court]] as a [[Translator/Legends|translator]], though he later left the court's service and became the partner of the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Jakarro]]. She was also the [[Parent/Legends|mother]] of [[King/Legends|King]] [[Regalun Petryph]].<ref name="Petryph" />
